consumer: mission::is_complete reading MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking whether the required item quantity is present in the player's crafting_inventory()
scope: on-person only: the player's worn/wielded/carried inventory, NOT reachable surroundings
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) tests u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges, a reach that includes adjacent/nearby crafting-accessible items
divergence: a detonator sitting in a crate on an adjacent tile (within crafting reach) while the player carries none on their body: crafting_inventory().has_amount returns true, but the on-person possession answer is false
